objective: Comprehensive 100-round deep empirical research dossier for Part 1: Order Fulfillment Fundamentals — From Click to Delivery. Establishing 2027 SOTA masterclass standards for The end-to-end lifecycle of an omnichannel e-commerce order across OMS, WMS, and TMS, event-driven state machines, and distributed locking.

key_findings: Decoupling the Order Management System (OMS) from Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) via asynchronous Kafka event streaming eliminates order ingestion backpressure during flash sales.
Two-phase inventory reservation with a 15-minute TTL reduces stock abandonment deadlocks while preventing double-selling across multiple channels.
State machine transitions between PENDING_ALLOCATION, ALLOCATED, RELEASED_TO_WMS, and PICKED require idempotency keys generated at checkout.
inferences: [INFERENCE] Event-driven choreography using transactional outbox patterns is mandatory to maintain consistency between OMS database and logistics microservices.
critical_gaps: Legacy ERP systems with batch polling intervals (>5 mins) introduce inventory visibility lag that compromises real-time allocation.
